facilities.name: City General Hospital
facilities.description: The heart of the medical quarter. Emergency care, operating theatres and intensive care serve the whole city.

facilities.name: Westbank Waterworks
facilities.description: Reservoirs and pumping infrastructure keep drinking water and firefighting pressure available across Nagar.

facilities.name: Nagar Communications
facilities.description: The communications tower connects emergency calls, utility operators and city residents.

facilities.name: Central Fire & Rescue
facilities.description: Fire crews, ambulances and emergency dispatch share this central response station.

facilities.name: Mobility Control Centre
facilities.description: The city's signal coordination centre keeps intersections and response routes moving.

facilities.name: Community Relief Centre
facilities.description: A community hall and open courtyard that can become a relief shelter during an emergency.

facilities.name: Eastside Logistics Depot
facilities.description: Storage and distribution facilities supporting fuel deliveries and backup generators.

facilities.name: Nagar Central Station
facilities.description: A transport hub with passenger platforms, sheltered trains, glazed canopies and a clock-fronted concourse.

facilities.name: West Garden Residences
facilities.description: Tree-lined residential streets, courtyards and neighborhood shops on Nagar's quieter western side.

facilities.name: Eastbank Business District
facilities.description: A cluster of offices and retail spaces anchors the city's commercial skyline.

facilities.name: East Grid Substation
facilities.description: The city's grid connection supplies three distribution buses. Electrical simulation will be connected in a later phase.
